chapter.verse: Pasian aw, ka lungsim a kigingsa-in om hi! Ka sa ding hi, phatna late ka sa ding hi! Kei ka tho ding hi.
Harp lasakna leh laiza lasakna aw, tho un! Zingsang khuavak hong phong ning!
Topa aw, mite lakah nang tung lungdamna kong pia ding a, minam dang lakah nangma tungah phatna ka sa ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na itna kip in vantung ban a, na thumanna in meiipite banto hi.
Pasian aw, vantungte’ tungah sangto lai in! Leitung khempeuhah na minthan’na om sak in!
Nangma it mite, nangma hatna tawh kote hong hon in la, kong ngetna hong pia in!
Ama biakinn sungah Pasian in thuciam khin hi: “Gualzo-a lungdamna tawh Shekhem gam khenkhia-in Sukkot gamkuam ka sehkhia ding hi.
Gilead gam in keima aa hi a, Manasseh gam in keima aa hi; Efraim gam in ka sik lukhu hi a, Judah gam in ka ciangkhut hi.
Moab gam in ka kisilna kuang hi a, Edom gam tungah ka khedap ka lawn hi; Filistia gam tungah gualzawhna tawh ka awng hi.
Kua in khuapi muanhuai-ah kei hong paipih ding hiam? Kua in Edom gamah kei hong paipih ding hiam?
Pasian aw, nangmah in kote hong don lo khin hi lo na hi hiam? Pasian aw, komau’ galkapte tawh na kuankhia kei hi.
Ka galdona uh-ah huhna kote hong pia in, bang hang hiam cih leh mihing’ huhna a mawkna hi!
Pasian tawh khauh takin i hih ding hi; amah in i galte hong sikcipsak dingpa ahi hi.
